billing_webhook_events_processing_lease_.name: billing_webhook_events_processing_lease_check
billing_webhook_events_processing_lease_.value: ("billing_webhook_events"."status" = 'processing') = ("billing_webhook_events"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "billing_webhook_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

plans_active_requires_ready_stripe_produ.name: plans_active_requires_ready_stripe_product_check
plans_active_requires_ready_stripe_produ.value: "plans"."is_active" = false OR ("plans"."provisioning_status" = 'ready' AND "plans"."stripe_product_id" IS NOT NULL)

subscriptions_current_period_order_check.name: subscriptions_current_period_order_check
subscriptions_current_period_order_check.value: "subscriptions"."current_period_start" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NULL OR "subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "subscriptions"."current_period_start"

product_images_alt_text_normalized_check.name: product_images_alt_text_normalized_check
product_images_alt_text_normalized_check.value: "product_images"."alt_text" IS NULL OR ("product_images"."alt_text" = trim("product_images"."alt_text") AND char_length("product_images"."alt_text") BETWEEN 1 AND 255)

product_variants_sku_normalized_check.name: product_variants_sku_normalized_check
product_variants_sku_normalized_check.value: "product_variants"."sku" IS NULL OR ("product_variants"."sku" = trim("product_variants"."sku") AND char_length("product_variants"."sku") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

product_variants_barcode_normalized_chec.name: product_variants_barcode_normalized_check
product_variants_barcode_normalized_chec.value: "product_variants"."barcode" IS NULL OR ("product_variants"."barcode" = trim("product_variants"."barcode") AND char_length("product_variants"."barcode") BETWEEN 1 AND 100)

product_variants_inventory_state_check.name: product_variants_inventory_state_check
product_variants_inventory_state_check.value:
("product_variants"."inventory_policy" = 'tracked' AND "product_variants"."on_hand" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."reserved" IS NOT NULL AND "product_variants"."on_hand" >= 0 AND "product_variants"."reserved" >= 0 AND "product_variants"."reserved" <= "product_variants"."on_hand")
        OR ("product_variants"."inventory_policy" = 'untracked' AND "product_variants"."on_hand" IS NULL AND "product_variants"."reserved" IS NULL)

product_variants_lifecycle_check.name: product_variants_lifecycle_check
product_variants_lifecycle_check.value:
("product_variants"."status" = 'active' AND "product_variants"."archived_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("product_variants"."status" = 'archived' AND "product_variants"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)

products_description_normalized_check.name: products_description_normalized_check
products_description_normalized_check.value: "products"."description" IS NULL OR ("products"."description" = trim("products"."description") AND char_length("products"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 50000)

products_lifecycle_timestamps_check.name: products_lifecycle_timestamps_check
products_lifecycle_timestamps_check.value:
("products"."status" = 'draft' AND "products"."published_at" IS NULL AND "products"."archived_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("products"."status" = 'published' AND "products"."published_at" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."archived_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("products"."status" = 'archived' AND "products"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL)
